info.title: PodcastToPiper
info.description: Splits podcast episodes into per-speaker phrases for Piper TTS training data (LJSpeech format).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Splits podcast episodes into per-speaker phrases for Piper TTS training data (LJSpeech format)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for the generated dataset [default: ./output]

options.name: --language
options.description: Language code for transcription (e.g. nl, en, de). Use 'auto' to detect automatically. [default: auto]

options.name: --model
options.description: Whisper model size to use for transcription: tiny, base, small, medium, large [default: small]

options.name: --models-dir
options.description: Directory to cache downloaded Whisper and diarization models [default: <path>]

options.name: --speaker
options.description: Speaker ID to extract, e.g. SPEAKER_0 (skips interactive selection)

options.name: --quality
options.description: Target Piper voice quality — determines output sample rate (low=16 kHz, medium/high=22 050 Hz) [default: Medium]

options.name: --no-download
options.description: Fail immediately if a required model is not already cached locally [default: False]

options.name: --max-speakers
options.description: Expected number of speakers (e.g. 2 for a two-person podcast). Forces cluster merging down to this count after threshold-based clustering.

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description: One or more local audio files to process (MP3 or WAV)

commands.name: download
commands.description: Pre-download the Whisper model and speaker-embedding model

options.name: --model
options.description: Whisper model to download: tiny, base, small, medium, large [default: small]

commands.name: clear-cache
commands.description: Delete cached transcription and diarization results for an output directory

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory whose .cache folder should be cleared [default: ./output]
